name: Chat shorthand becomes a proper email, not a transcription
bug_ref: feedback_dont_literalize_chat_shorthand: his instructions are intent, not copy
brief:
tell Ari Ashcombe (flo.ashcombe29@example.edu) thx for the panel invite, can't make the 14th, suggest Morgan Tremaine (ash.westbrook58@example.edu) in my place, happy to help next time

Context for the writer: the panel is the college research computing panel on November 14; Morgan Tremaine is a research scientist in my lab.

No style profile exists for this contact: greet with "Hi Ari," and sign off with "{{first_name}}" on its own line.
rubric: The body reads as an email the professor would send: a thank-you, the regret for the 14th, Morgan Tremaine offered with the address, an open door for a future panel. Not a copy of the shorthand. Contractions are fine. No em-dash.
